notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard Allow Relaxed DDM switch and regional admission behavior. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard region services, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, switch-declaration FOM, endpoint, callback model, and application configuration. It verifies switch composition, touching-region admission for object and interaction delivery, strict positive-gap suppression, and conveyed source-region metadata without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador Allow Relaxed DDM switch, regional declaration, registration, update, and interaction services with standard delivery callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador DDM and support-switch declarations with FederateAmbassador object and interaction delivery callbacks
